acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Consumer compatibility with the full TanStack Table capability set](../decisions/tanstack-table-compatibility.md). The design system does not integrate/run TanStack Table. Applications own processing, state and workers; the house Table provides structure, appearance and interaction/measurement access. Earlier house-adapter proposals misread the request.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Native HTML forms plus optional TanStack Form](../decisions/native-and-managed-forms.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [No server-side rendering](../decisions/server-rendering.md). Excluded, not deferred. Server data processing remains possible.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Material spring roles and both Standard/Expressive schemes](../decisions/material-motion-system.md), chosen by context; retain Lit Motion.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Shape morphing follows demonstrated component needs](../decisions/shape-support.md). The later clarification supersedes the broad Material catalogue requirement. Use ordinary shape properties first and custom geometry only for a concrete need; no geometry package is selected. The earlier accidental option remains withdrawn.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Wrap complete names in multi-line ComboBox options](../decisions/combobox-long-labels.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Overlapping Toasts, newest messages visible, implemented with the house stack](../decisions/toast-behaviour.md). No Zag Toast dependency.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Explicit activation for interactive rich help](../decisions/rich-help-activation.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Full visual themes on pages and nested sections](../decisions/custom-themes.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Darker blue with white text](../decisions/blue-accent.md), selected after the original blue example failed the measured normal-text contrast threshold. Exact per-control/state values and broader contrast verification remain open.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Oxlint + Oxfmt with Ultracite, plus Stylelint](../decisions/lint-toolchain.md), for the later migration.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: Keep Toast under the existing community-naming rule; the [survey](../analysis/floating-surface-shadows.md#phase-1-extension-toast-and-rich-help) supports it. This was a research conclusion, not a new explicit naming vote.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: Always evaluate the actual Material Web Lit implementation alongside Material guidance. The [reference decision](../decisions/reference-systems.md) retains this requirement.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Responsive layout and appearance with Material bands and font-relative thresholds](../decisions/responsive-system.md). Three distinct choices; exact interface remains open.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Box as a planned primitive](../decisions/box-primitive.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Versioned consumer skills](../decisions/consumer-skills.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [A version-matched documentation/API MCP server](../decisions/design-system-mcp.md), explicitly requested in the same reply as the skills selection.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [TanStack Intent as development tooling](../decisions/intent-tooling.md).
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [AI authoring support only in this pass](../decisions/ai-authoring-scope.md); no live AI component control.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [A shared Lit/React inspector using TanStack Devtools](../decisions/design-system-devtools.md), explicitly confirmed after the Solid dependency was explained.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Ripples off by default, with opt-in support](../decisions/optional-ripples.md). Configuration scope and applicable controls remain for the inventory; selection-state animations remain part of the separate motion decision.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [TanStack Virtual for both Lit and React virtualization](../decisions/tanstack-table-compatibility.md#framework-rendering-and-virtualization), explicitly confirmed. For Table, the application connects it to our exposed layout/measurement targets.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Reusable results pagination](../decisions/results-pagination.md): numbered/compact controls and unknown totals; application-owned page state/loading and no TanStack Table dependency. The earlier page-size recipe boundary is [under review](../decisions/results-pagination.md#review-pending-after-the-chakra-ui-pro-example): evaluate optional page-position, page-size and navigation parts together before the inventory is approved. Jump-to-page detail remains separate.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Resizable panes](../decisions/resizable-panes.md): user resizing by drag/keyboard, optional collapse with previous-size restoration, and application-owned preference saving remain selected. The original @zag-js/splitter runtime choice is superseded by the native port strategy below. Correct the known behaviour inconsistencies in the house port; exact interfaces remain open.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Shared density](../decisions/density.md): spacing-only page/section settings, normal by default; menus/dialogs/Toasts retain normal inherited spacing; compact buttons/similar controls have a 24 × 24 CSS-pixel clickable-area floor with larger touch-friendly sizing available. Three separate answers; no universal 48px normal-mode target was selected.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Both reading directions](../decisions/bidirectional-support.md) for pages and sections in Lit/React, including keyboard behaviour, appropriate icons and mixed-direction content. Applications supply translations.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Shared moving selection indicators](../decisions/shared-selection-indicator.md) using Lit Motion for suitable single-selection groups. Each control keeps its appearance/selection rules; no additional Zag dependency.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Native Lit behaviour ports using the full house stack](../decisions/zag-behaviour-ports.md) supersede the earlier five-control Zag runtime/adapter selection. Peter rejects a Zag adapter and its createMachine/state mechanism, requires the established TanStack Store and Lit Motion approaches plus all other applicable house rules, and explicitly permits new components, rebuilds or replacements. React wraps the same implementation. Selected capabilities remain.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded

acceptedExtensions.sourceText: [Independent Adobe number utilities](../decisions/number-utilities.md) for Number Input parsing/formatting, retaining the full house implementation. Version 3.6.8 was researched, not pinned for future release; installation remains gated by migration approval.
acceptedExtensions.status: Carried into complete proposal set or explicitly excluded
